scope: Lossy source coding, rate-distortion, quantization, continuous/Gaussian scope, finite-memoryless Wyner-Ziv and Berger-Tung multiterminal proofs, successive refinement, exact scalar quadratic-Gaussian two-encoder rate region, source-channel separation, and current-library supplier audit.
evidence_basis: Read the complete Gray *Source Coding Theory* author-hosted first-edition PDF, pages 1-197 including exercises, full bibliography, and index; addressed equation loss in the embedded OCR through a second formula OCR pass and visually checked scan pages 77-80.

Read MIT OCW 6.441 Spring 2016 chapters 23, 24 and 25 in full, including the finite-block lossy coding bounds, iid source-coding proof, Gaussian/Hamming examples, source-channel separation proof and Assumption A1.
Read the full Wyner-Ziv 1976 article including both appendices and references, and the full Equitz-Cover 1991 article including its proof, examples, counterexample and references.

Added an independent finite-alphabet Blahut proof with boundary optimizer handling, a KL telescope, an explicit objective iteration bound, and an a-posteriori log-gamma certificate; Gray itself omits this proof.
Inspected current library suppliers and recorded exact available foundations, specialized near-misses, and missing source-coding theorem interfaces.

Added a standalone finite-memoryless WZ and k-source Berger-Tung proof development, with explicit type-covering bounds, selected-codeword Markov lemma, all-subset binning exponents, a locally proved |U|<=|X|+1 WZ reduction, and an explicit no-rate-loss criterion/example.
Read the complete relevant WTV theorem/converse/direct-test-channel sections and Appendices B-E from the r5-owned author preprint, while preserving r5's full-article ownership and read claim.

Added a local Gaussian CEO extremal converse using message-likelihood Fisher information, a conditional-entropy-to-Fisher trace bound, and a proved Bayesian Cramér-Rao step; derived the beta sum-rate formula and exact scalar-Gaussian test-channel region. Then closed the scalar-face Gaussian-summand entropy-power step by proving the de Bruijn/Stam heat-flow route and the finite-message posterior smoothing limit locally.
handoff_contents: Finite-alphabet code/RDF definitions, existence and attainment conditions, converse and iid expected-distortion achievability proof routes, with expected-distortion/excess-distortion distinction.

Finite-alphabet Blahut update definitions, support assumptions, monotonicity, global convergence proof including boundary optimizers, objective accuracy bound, log-gamma stopping certificate, operation count and finite-precision contract.
Exact scalar and finite-vector Gaussian MSE formulas; stationary Gaussian spectral reverse-water-filling formula with its extra Toeplitz and operational proof requirements clearly marked.

Quantizer/codebook definitions, Lloyd and Viterbi correctness scope, high-resolution point-density formulas, smooth-cell and negligible-overload assumptions, and deterministic-input quantization-noise counterexamples.
Finite-alphabet Wyner-Ziv theorem and aux-cardinality bound; conditional-RDF distinction; Equitz-Cover Markov compatibility criterion, examples and nonrefinable counterexample.
Lossy source-channel separation converse/achievability with finite-alphabet bounded-distortion sufficient case and the exact broader Assumption A1 conditions.
Current published supplier map and near-miss audit for finite entropy, KL, convexity, probability kernels, and integrability.

Complete finite-iid WZ converse/achievability and no-rate-loss proof; complete k-source finite-memoryless Berger-Tung inner-bound proof for all subset rates, time sharing and closure, with no unsupported auxiliary-cardinality reduction.

Complete local proof of the scalar quadratic-Gaussian two-encoder exact region for unit-variance correlation 0<rho<1 and positive expected-MSE targets, including the scalar-face Gaussian-summand EPI proof, continuous Gaussian test-channel achievability by finite approximation, and a locally proved CEO extremal/sum converse.
limitations: Gray §4.4 does not prove Blahut convergence; the finite-alphabet proof is supplied locally in findings.md and assumes finite distortion entries and finite Lagrange parameter.
Gray's continuous variational equations refer to Csiszár for rigor. General Borel-alphabet existence/attainment, lsc/compactness, and continuous BA convergence are not claimed.

The stationary Gaussian-process reverse-waterfilling formula is presented with a bounded-spectrum sufficient proof route, but Gray defers its derivation to Berger/Gallager and the full operational proof is not part of the read source set.
High-rate quantizer formulas remain fixed-dimension asymptotics under smooth density, shrinking cells, and negligible overload; they are not finite-rate guarantees.
The source-channel theorem is for memoryless source/channel and bounded distortion or the stated A1 integrability/geometric conditions; cost constraints and general channels are out of scope.
The Wyner-Ziv and successive-refinement theorems retain their finite-alphabet/iid and memoryless-source hypotheses; Y-dependent distortion and arbitrary continuous extensions need separate theorems.

The WTV supplement proves the exact two-scalar Gaussian/MSE model stated in its note, including the CEO converse; it does not extend to arbitrary Gaussian vector sources, more than two terminals, zero distortion, or excess-distortion criteria.
The Berger-Tung proof takes arbitrary finite auxiliaries and finite time-sharing as its union; it proves no universal small cardinality bound for those auxiliaries.
